svg.title: API-equivalent cost versus main functional score
svg.desc: All eighteen model and effort settings: x is frozen API-equivalent dollars per attempt and y is the six-task main functional macro score out of one hundred. The main panel shows the full score scale with headroom. A clearly labeled detail panel shows low-cost near-ceiling settings without moving their points. Sol 6 Max and Ultra costs are observed lower bounds, shown with rightward arrows. Efforts are joined in order within each model.
svg.text: What does more money buy on these coding tasks?
Cost per attempt versus main functional score · 6 tasks × 2 repetitions per setting
Includes the recorded provider-failure stub grade
Most functional scores reach the ceiling.
Equal scores can overlap; no points are jittered.
Functional score grades the saved code.
It is separate from accepted delivery and from
maintainability or a full code-quality rating.
* Sol 6 Max / Ultra: observed cost lower bounds. Rightward arrows mean the complete cost is unknown.
Lines follow effort order, not interpolation. Upper-left means less money and a higher measured functional score.
